description: Focused Cilium (CNI) + Hubble network operations dashboard: identity/endpoint health, policy enforcement & drops, flow verdicts, datapath/BPF pressure and agent health. Replaces the community Cilium dashboards with one clean answer to "is cluster networking healthy?". Deep BPF-map analysis lives in the separate Cilium BPF Pressure dashboard.

panels.description: Number of cilium-agent instances currently exporting metrics (deduped via container="cilium-agent"). Should equal the node count.
panels.title: Cilium Agents Up

panels.description: Total Cilium endpoints (pods) in the ready state across all nodes.
panels.title: Endpoints Ready

panels.description: Endpoints not in ready state (regenerating, waiting-for-identity, restoring, disconnecting). Sustained non-zero indicates datapath churn.
panels.title: Endpoints Not-Ready

panels.description: Max nodes reported unreachable by any agent's health prober. Non-zero = node-to-node connectivity broken.
panels.title: Unreachable Nodes

panels.description: Sum of failing Cilium controllers across all agents. Non-zero = an internal reconcile loop (identity, endpoint, policy, etc.) is stuck.
panels.title: Controllers Failing

panels.description: Cluster-wide CiliumIdentity count (max per-node total). WATCH: the 2026-05 meltdown was CiliumIdentity bloat — sustained growth into the thousands = label-filter regression.
panels.title: Cilium Identities

panels.description: Aggregate cilium datapath drop rate (packets/s), all reasons & directions. Baseline is small (ICMP/NAT noise); spikes warrant a Drops-by-Reason look below.
panels.title: Datapath Drop Rate

panels.description: Count of node-to-node connectivity probes reporting unreachable (cilium_node_connectivity_status==0). 0 = full mesh reachability.
panels.title: Unhealthy Node Links

panels.description: Hubble-observed flow rate split by verdict. FORWARDED is normal traffic; DROPPED tracks enforcement/datapath drops; TRACED/TRANSLATED are trace + NAT events.
panels.title: Flow Rate by Verdict

panels.description: Hubble drop rate by reason. Correlate with the Cilium policy-drop panels below; INVALID/STALE IP + ICMP noise is expected background.
panels.title: Drops by Reason (Hubble)

panels.description: Rate of FORWARDED flows by L4 protocol (TCP/UDP/ICMP). Shows the traffic mix carried by the datapath.
panels.title: Forwarded Traffic by Protocol

panels.description: Rate of observed TCP control flags. A rising RST rate relative to SYN/FIN signals connection resets / refused or aborted connections.
panels.title: TCP Flags Rate

panels.description: Cilium datapath forward vs drop packet rate. Drop line sits far below forward in a healthy cluster; a converging gap means enforcement or datapath trouble.
panels.title: Forwarded vs Dropped (Datapath)

panels.description: Cilium drop rate broken down by reason. "Policy denied" here is the authoritative network-policy enforcement drop; other reasons are datapath/NAT noise.
panels.title: Datapath Drops by Reason

panels.description: Cilium drop rate split by traffic direction (INGRESS vs EGRESS) to localize where drops originate.
panels.title: Datapath Drops by Direction

panels.description: Packets dropped specifically due to network-policy denial (reason="Policy denied"). Sustained non-zero = a workload is hitting a deny rule — expected for default-deny namespaces, investigate otherwise.
panels.title: Policy-Denied Drop Rate

panels.description: Hubble policy-verdict rate by action (forwarded/denied). Sparse by design — only populates when CiliumNetworkPolicies actively match flows.
panels.title: Hubble Policy Verdicts

panels.description: Top BPF maps by fill ratio (max across nodes). Summary only — see the dedicated "Cilium BPF Pressure" dashboard for per-node/per-map deep dive. Approaching 1.0 risks map-full drops.
panels.title: BPF Map Pressure (summary)

panels.description: Rate of endpoint datapath regenerations by outcome. Regeneration follows policy/identity changes; any sustained failure rate is a red flag.
panels.title: Endpoint Regeneration Rate

panels.description: Cluster identity count over time (total + by type). The historical companion to the Identities stat — a steady upward ramp is the CiliumIdentity-bloat signature.
panels.title: Identity Count Trend

panels.description: Endpoints grouped by state over time. A healthy cluster is almost entirely "ready"; transient bumps in regenerating/waiting states are normal during rollouts.
panels.title: Endpoint State Distribution

panels.description: Node-to-node health-probe latency per target node (node datapath path). Rising latency indicates degraded inter-node networking.
panels.title: Node Connectivity Latency

panels.description: Rate of observation events Hubble dropped (ring-buffer overflow or full observer queue). Non-zero means the flow data above is incomplete, not that the datapath is dropping traffic.
panels.title: Hubble Lost Events
CrowdSec Active Bans
panels.description: Total active CrowdSec ban decisions (LAPI). Sum of cs_active_decisions{action="ban"} across all origins (CAPI community blocklist + local crowdsec). High counts are normal for the community blocklist.

panels.title: AppSec Requests/s
panels.description: Rate of requests processed by the CrowdSec AppSec (WAF) component. Zero if AppSec is idle / no traffic routed through it.

panels.title: LB-IPAM IPs Available
panels.description: Cilium LB-IPAM free IPs remaining across all pools (cilium_operator_lbipam_ips_available_total). Trending toward 0 = LoadBalancer IP pool exhaustion.

panels.title: LB-IPAM IPs Used
panels.description: Cilium LB-IPAM IPs currently allocated to Services across all pools (cilium_operator_lbipam_ips_used_total).

panels.title: LB Services Unsatisfied
panels.description: Services requesting a LoadBalancer IP that LB-IPAM could NOT satisfy (cilium_operator_lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total). Non-zero = a Service is stuck pending an external IP — silent LB IP starvation.

panels.title: Edge 403s/s
panels.description: Rate of HTTP 403 responses served at the Traefik entrypoints — predominantly CrowdSec bouncer drops of banned clients. Sustained rise = active enforcement / attack in progress.

panels.title: Active Decisions by Reason (top 10)
panels.description: CrowdSec active decisions grouped by the scenario/reason that triggered them (topk 10). Identifies which attack classes dominate the current ban list.

panels.title: Active Decisions by Origin
panels.description: CrowdSec active decisions split by origin (CAPI = community blocklist, crowdsec = locally-detected). Tracks how much of enforcement is community vs. self-detected.

panels.title: Bucket Overflows/s
panels.description: Rate of CrowdSec leaky-bucket overflows by scenario (cs_bucket_overflowed_total) — each overflow is a scenario firing that produces an alert/decision. The leading indicator of new bans.

panels.title: LB-IPAM Pool Utilization
panels.description: Cilium LB-IPAM available vs. used IPs over time (per pool). Converging lines / available approaching 0 predicts LoadBalancer IP starvation.

panels.title: cert-manager Sync Errors/s
panels.description: Rate of cert-manager controller sync errors by controller (certmanager_controller_sync_error_count). Complements the cert-expiry panels above: catches issuance/renewal failures BEFORE a cert actually expires.

panels.title: Edge 403s/s (bouncer drops)
panels.description: Rate of HTTP 403 responses per Traefik entrypoint (traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{code="403"}) — the timeseries companion to the Edge 403s stat, mostly CrowdSec bouncer denials of banned clients.

title: Network Ops — Cilium & Hubble
